edges.reason: msg.sender is consumed as the account whose tokens are burned or pulled inside swapTokensForCredits
giftCredits is guarded by onlyOwner which compares owner() with _msgSender()
setTokenSwapOption is guarded by onlyOwner which compares owner() with _msgSender()
withdrawTokens is guarded by onlyOwner which compares owner() with _msgSender()
setEnabled is guarded by onlyOwner which compares owner() with _msgSender()
_authorizeUpgrade is restricted by onlyOwner, gating proxy upgrades on msg.sender
stored _owner value determines whether _authorizeUpgrade may proceed
stored _owner value determines whether giftCredits may proceed
stored _owner value determines whether setTokenSwapOption may proceed
stored _owner value determines whether withdrawTokens may proceed
stored _owner value determines whether setEnabled may proceed
isEnabled modifier requires _enabled to be true before swapTokensForCredits body executes
setEnabled writes the _enabled state flag
swapTokensForCredits reads _tokenSwapOptions[tokenContract] to obtain price, burn and enabled flags
setTokenSwapOption writes price, enabled and burn into _tokenSwapOptions
tokenSwapOption view returns the stored _tokenSwapOptions entry
amount is cast to uint256 and multiplied by option.price then divided by 10**18 to compute value
computed value is passed as the burn amount to the external token contract
computed value is passed as the transferFrom amount to the external token contract
caller-supplied tokenContract selects the external contract that receives burnFrom
caller-supplied tokenContract selects the external contract that receives safeTransferFrom
local account is assigned from _msgSender() at call time
account is used as the address whose tokens are burned
account is used as the from address of the token pull
storage pointer option controls branching and pricing inside swapTokensForCredits
option.burn selects the burnFrom external call path
external burnFrom call on an attacker-controlled token can reenter swapTokensForCredits before state/emission completes
external safeTransferFrom call on a malicious token can reenter swapTokensForCredits mid-execution
external token transfer inside withdrawTokens hands control to a hostile token that can reenter the contract
tokenContract parameter is the mapping key written by setTokenSwapOption
price parameter is narrowed to uint128 and stored in _tokenSwapOptions
tokenContract parameter selects the external token contract invoked in withdrawTokens
amount parameter is forwarded to the external token transfer in withdrawTokens
newImplementation parameter is validated and installed by the upgrade authorization hook
initialize sets the _owner slot to the deployer via __Ownable_init
tokenContract parameter is the lookup key of the tokenSwapOption view
